evidence_kind: Native build-fixture path identity and source provenance; no audio or hardware measurements
registration_order: Publish this contract before implementing or evaluating the corrected predicate.
mechanism: Windows gives the temporary directory through the RUNNER~1 short-name alias while CMake emits the equivalent runneradmin long path. Native diagnostics prove identical resolved absolute paths and samefile=true. The lexical pathlib comparison fails although the prescribed generated file, native filename and language extension are correct.

preserved.predicate_scope: Only the generated-wrapper lexical path equality changes. All 92 existing checks, bridge checks, byte/hash checks, upstream non-mutation, helper order, configure dependencies, malformed-source rejection and LF/CRLF equivalence remain mandatory. The ordinary native Windows CTest gate and separate early source-contract job both run the full suite.

corrected_predicate.combination: All three requirements are combined with AND in the same existing check call. Missing files, different canonical targets, wrong names or wrong language extensions cannot pass.
corrected_predicate.why_not_lexical: An OS-supported alias denotes the same filesystem object; acceptance concerns the exact generated translation unit, its basename and native language, not one of the valid spellings of its parent directory.
corrected_predicate.diagnostics: Retain raw actual/expected paths, both resolved absolute paths and samefile result before the assertion.

qualification.portable: Run the entire existing host-wrapper fixture against pinned JUCE c352e2489000ffeb9e397051377d75eef2efe641 on the local host after benchmarking permits it. It must report 92 checks, zero failures.
qualification.native_windows: Run the independent windows-2022 source-contract job. The observed short/long alias case must pass all 92 checks with the hash-validated pinned source. A local POSIX pass alone does not qualify the Windows correction.
qualification.native_build: The ordinary Windows plugin build/CTest and all other platform gates remain required; no cross-platform dependency or bypass is introduced.

mutations.name: redirect_to_existing_different_file
mutations.isolated_change: In a temporary HostAutomation.cmake copy, append the existing original _cs80_source to _cs80_patched_sources instead of the generated _cs80_wrapper for a VST3 fixture, while still generating the output. Both files exist and share the correct basename, but have different resolved absolute paths and filesystem identities.
mutations.expected_result: The unchanged corrected fixture fails the generated-wrapper identity assertion at its first VST3 case; it must not accept an existing file merely because its basename is correct.

mutations.name: change_generated_native_extension
mutations.isolated_change: In a temporary HostAutomation.cmake copy, when the selected original source is juce_audio_plugin_client_VST3.cpp, write and select the generated output as juce_audio_plugin_client_VST3.mm instead. The source text and automation bridge remain generated, but the prescribed filename/native extension is wrong.
mutations.expected_result: The unchanged corrected fixture fails the exact-basename/native-extension assertion at its first VST3 case. A valid existing generated file cannot pass under the wrong native filename.

restoration: After both isolated mutations fail, rerun the original production fixture; it must still report all 92 checks with zero failures.
